cause: Invalid username or password. User provided incorrect credentials.
reasoning: The credentials provided do not match any account in the directory. This is typically a typo or expired password.
action_detail: Prompt the user to re-enter credentials or reset their password.
user_message: Your username or password is incorrect. Please try again or reset your password.

cause: A silent sign-in request was sent but no user is signed in. The session cookie is missing or expired.
reasoning: The application tried to silently acquire a token but no active session exists. An interactive login is required.
action_detail: Redirect user to interactive login flow using MSAL loginRedirect or loginPopup.
user_message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

cause: User or administrator has not consented to use the application. Send an interactive authorization request for this user and resource.
reasoning: The application requires permissions that have not been granted. The user must go through an OAuth consent flow.
action_detail: Redirect user to consent URL with prompt=consent parameter to force consent screen.
user_message: This app needs your permission to access your data. Please approve the permissions request.

cause: Application was not found in the directory or tenant. This can happen if the application has not been installed by the administrator of the tenant.
reasoning: The client_id does not exist in the current tenant. The user may be signed into the wrong tenant.
action_detail: Guide user to sign in to the correct tenant or contact their admin to register the app.
user_message: This application is not registered in your organization. Make sure you're signed into the correct account or contact your IT admin.

cause: No redirect URI was provided in the app registration. OAuth flow cannot complete without a valid redirect URI.
reasoning: The application's redirect URI is missing or does not match what was sent in the auth request. This is fixed by updating the app registration in Azure AD.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API PATCH /applications/{id} to add the redirect URI to the app registration.
user_message: Missing redirect URI in app registration. Fixing automatically via MS Graph API.

cause: The user's password has expired and must be reset before they can sign in.
reasoning: Password expiry is enforced by the tenant policy. An admin can force a password reset via Graph API.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API PATCH /users/{id} with forceChangePasswordNextSignIn=true.
user_message: User's password has expired. Triggering password reset via MS Graph API.

cause: The user account has been disabled in Azure Active Directory.
reasoning: Account disable is an admin-level action. It can be reversed by patching the user's accountEnabled property.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API PATCH /users/{id} with accountEnabled=true.
user_message: User account is disabled. Re-enabling account via MS Graph API.

cause: Invalid client credentials. The application secret or certificate used for authentication is incorrect or expired.
reasoning: App secrets have an expiry date or may have been regenerated. A new secret must be created and the old one removed.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API POST /applications/{id}/addPassword to add new secret, then DELETE old credential.
user_message: App client credentials are invalid. Rotating application secret via MS Graph API.

cause: Admin consent is required. The application is requesting permissions that can only be granted by a tenant administrator.
reasoning: Certain scopes (e.g., User.Read.All, Group.ReadWrite.All) require admin consent. This can be granted programmatically.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API POST /oauth2PermissionGrants or use the admin consent endpoint to grant tenant-wide consent.
user_message: Admin consent required for this application. Granting consent via MS Graph API.

cause: Multi-factor authentication is required but was not completed. The user must perform MFA.
reasoning: MFA is enforced by Conditional Access policy. The user must complete MFA during the interactive login flow.
action_detail: Redirect user to interactive login so they can complete the MFA challenge.
user_message: Multi-factor authentication is required. Please sign in again to complete the MFA step.

cause: The provided scope is invalid or not supported for this application.
reasoning: The scope requested doesn't match the API permissions configured in the app registration.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API PATCH /applications/{id} to add the required resourceAccess permissions.
user_message: Invalid scope requested. Updating API permissions in app registration via MS Graph API.

cause: User account from external identity provider does not exist in tenant.
reasoning: Guest user invitations or B2B federation issues require admin review and manual resolution.
action_detail: Generate escalation message for admin to invite external user or configure B2B federation.
user_message: Your account is not recognized in this organization. Your IT admin needs to invite you or configure external access.

cause: Account is locked out due to too many failed sign-in attempts.
reasoning: Smart lockout or account protection policy has locked the account. An admin can unlock it via Graph API.
action_detail: Call MS Graph API POST /users/{id}/authentication/methods to clear sign-in lockout.
user_message: Account is locked due to too many failed attempts. Unlocking account via MS Graph API.

cause: A transient error has occurred. Please retry.
reasoning: Azure AD service experienced a temporary fault. No configuration change is needed.
action_detail: Wait 5-10 seconds and retry the authentication request.
user_message: A temporary error occurred with Microsoft's authentication service. Please wait a moment and try again.

cause: The refresh token has expired. The session is too old and the token can no longer be silently refreshed.
reasoning: Refresh tokens expire based on tenant policy (typically 90 days inactive). User must re-authenticate.
action_detail: Clear the token cache and redirect user to interactive sign-in.
user_message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
